shows.creative_promise: A peculiar invention fails in a surprising but causally readable way every episode.

visual_direction.description: Original soft geometric laboratory characters with unequal asymmetrical eyes, rounded hexagon props, paper-like modular backgrounds; flat 2D vector art with extremely simple shadows.
visual_direction.movement: Elastic transform-based comedy, carefully timed anticipation and reaction; no copied stick figure designs.
visual_direction.negative_prompt: No known cartoon characters, no Pencilmation identifiers, no imitation of artist-specific linework, no text artifacts, no brand logos

shows.creative_promise: Colossal cosmic emergencies receive banal municipal responses from uniquely flawed workers.

visual_direction.description: Original angular cutout figure rigs made from irregular stationery-like shapes; fluorescent civic office with angular windows, handwritten case stickers and graphic-designed forms; no rural outdoor animation resemblance.
visual_direction.movement: Deadpan held poses, slow unmotivated camera pushes, asymmetric jaw and eyebrow changes, occasional sudden prop actions.
visual_direction.negative_prompt: No Big Lez, no Sasquatch, no recognizable Australian bush cartoon motifs, no existing character silhouettes, no original series quotes or music

shows.creative_promise: A fictional late-night archivist receives a strange transmission; each episode changes what the town believes is possible.

visual_direction.description: Original two-tone inked city panels and a geometric radio studio, subtle paper grain, elongated rectangular architecture, cyan frequency graphics and sparse amber warning lights.
visual_direction.movement: Limited character movement, parallax panels, shadow passes, small push-ins and audio-driven cuts; no photorealism.
visual_direction.negative_prompt: No real missing persons, no fake found-footage documentary claims, no copied horror-creepypasta characters, no recognizable film/game creature designs
